hook.name: SlotMachineHook
hook.description: A gamified hook that collects a configurable fee (default 2%) on all swaps via BeforeSwapDelta, splitting it into dual per-pool ETH jackpots. On qualifying ETH buys (above a configurable minimum), it triggers a slot machine spin for the buyer; winning combinations (pair, two-pair, three-of-a-kind, four-of-a-kind) pay out ETH directly. Sell fees are converted to ETH via a JackpotSellExecutor. Buyers receive SpinToken ERC-20 tokens for additional spins.
